claim: For a game that XORs figures, toggling the overlay on every plot keeps it exact through erase, draw and redraw with no place list.

evidence.text: Each plot repeated on the Layer 2 overlay by toggling (255 <-> 7); no place list; XOR on eight planes equals XOR on the value when the buffer holds the set's own 8-bit values.
Erasing calls name the place they already are; balls use a sprite per call.
ULA XOR shadow equals the original screen at every moment; on one shared XOR layer Dizzy and the grease gun cancelled each other's pixels.
